author: ThioJoe
description:
EVERY program must add this feature NOW.

Feature Request thread: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/570465258

I was doing some searching for certain terms within a PDF recently and encountered an annoyance that I have countless times before. You want to search for something, you know what you're looking for, but there's a ton of matches for the word. To find what you need, you need to click a million times on the "Next" button, even when you can see that none of the results on the current page are what you want. But what if there was a better way. A way to simply skip all the results visible so you can go right to parts you haven't seen, and more quickly scan large web pages or documents for what you're looking for.
